attributes.summary:
An inexpensive way to pick up addiction hours from a jointly accredited provider, with a virtual option on the same day. Hours are promised for social workers and Indiana-licensed MFTs, among others; the listing does not name counselors in the CE line even though they are invited, so Indiana LMHCs should ask before registering.

The $140 professional price holds through April 30, then rises to $155. The hour total and speakers are not published, and the page currently shows registration as closed, which looks like a leftover from the last edition.
